failure_step: Run voice and extras interaction checks first

first_failure.reason: The native MixerValue slider uses quadratic or decibel conversion. Its fractional position is not the linear amplitude returned by preferences.get_volume.

correction: Retain the actual 25% physical slider click. Check the normalized native MixerValue position, with the pinned quadratic/decibel range, and log its volume and mixer value. Do not replace the mouse operation with a programmatic set_volume call. Publish bounded prefix images before the long regression so new views can be inspected early.
review_limits: Locked extras, real unlocks, full image viewer, next/previous and pause assertions reached successfully. No complete extras acceptance or EXE regression is claimed for this run.
